# Blackmagic Design

> > Professional video technology company creating digital film cameras, post-production software, and live production equipment for Hollywood and creative professionals worldwide.

Blackmagic Design, founded by Grant Petty, develops industry-leading products including DaVinci Resolve for editing and color correction, URSA and PYXIS cinema cameras with Blackmagic RAW, and ATEM switchers for live production. The company has won Emmy awards for its innovative video technology and serves the professional film and television industry.

## Key Topics

- DaVinci Resolve
- Blackmagic RAW
- Digital Film Cameras
- Post-Production
- Color Correction
- Visual Effects
- Blackmagic PYXIS 12K
- Blackmagic Cloud
- ATEM Switchers
- DeckLink
- Fairlight Audio
- HDR Workflows
- AI IntelliScript
- Live Production
- Professional Video

## Flagship Products

- [DaVinci Resolve](https://www.blackmagicdesign.com/products/davinciresolve): DaVinci Resolve 20: video editing, color, VFX & audio post production
- [Blackmagic Camera](https://www.blackmagicdesign.com/products/blackmagiccamera): Cinema camera app for iPhone, iPad & Android with cloud recording
- [Products Catalog](https://www.blackmagicdesign.com/products/): Product catalog: cameras, converters, DaVinci Resolve, and switchers
